newsitem.title: USA: Black Hawk, Jacobs delay stock purchase.
newsitem.headline: Black Hawk, Jacobs delay stock purchase.

text.p: Black Hawk Gaming & Development Co Inc and Jacobs Entertainment Ltd will postpone until November 1 the closing of a stock purchase agreement reached earlier this month, Black Hawk said Friday.
Black Hawk, which operates and owns 50 percent of the Gilpin Hotel Casino in Black Hawk, Colorado, said the delay will enable it to complete the annual renewal of the hotel's gaming license.

It said it expected the license to be renewed even though an investigation by the Jefferson County District Attorney into check cashing and credit extension policies at the hotel and other casinos in Colorado had raised some concerns.

"It is simply a matter of assuring that there are no unresolved matters associated with the company prior to my making a significant investment," it cited Jacobs as saying. " We thought this issue would be resolved by this time."
